submission.justification: After comprehensive analysis, Mixture-G3 at 2 mm gap is recommended as it is the ONLY mixture that meets the environmental GWP100 ≤ 150 hard requirement. However, it must be noted that NO feasible solution exists that satisfies both hard requirements simultaneously. Mixture-G3 achieves a time resolution of 2.015 ns, which exceeds the 1.5 ns requirement by 0.515 ns (34% over target). Mixtures G1 and G2, while achieving better time resolution (0.9 ns and 1.3 ns respectively), violate the laboratory's mandatory environmental policy. Given that environmental regulations are typically non-negotiable legal/policy constraints, while technical specifications may sometimes be relaxed through engineering trade-offs, Mixture-G3 represents the most responsible choice. The project stakeholders should be informed of this constraint conflict and consider either: (1) accepting the degraded time resolution, (2) requesting an environmental policy exception, or (3) researching alternative mixture candidates that meet both requirements.

requirements.requirement: Achieve the best possible time resolution
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G3 at 2mm gap achieves 2.015 ns, which is the best among GWP-compliant options but not the best overall (G1 achieves 0.9 ns).

requirements.requirement: Time resolution must be 1.5 ns or better (hard requirement)
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G3 achieves 2.015 ns at optimal 2mm gap, exceeding the 1.5 ns requirement by 0.515 ns. Optimization across gaps 1-3mm confirmed 2mm as optimal.
Mixture-G3 is GWP100 compliant (mixture_G3_gwp100_compliant = 1). Only 1 of 3 candidate mixtures meets this requirement.
Recommended gap of 2 mm is within the specified range of 1-3 mm.

requirements.requirement: Must be one of the three candidate mixtures
requirements.evidence: Mixture-G3 is one of the three candidates listed in candidate_specs.md.
